rationale: Plan directly addresses task objectives: group_comparison cross-tabulates provider_specialty and network_status to compare volume (claim_count), paid amounts (sum and mean), denial rate, and fraud_rate across both dimensions. provider_ranking selects the ten rendering providers with most claims. All required artifacts produced. Includes synthetic_data caveat per prior feedback (T2), shows denominators for rate transparency (T2 lesson), and avoids unnecessary small_groups caveat (T4 lesson) by setting min_group_size=30 without including the caveat unless groups are actually flagged as small.
